defs.def: of high quality; good 高质量的；美好的

ex.s: This not-so-hidden-anymore fine restaurant for Sichuan cuisine is inside the Days Inn off New York Avenue.
ex.t: 这家已不再那么隐秘的川菜精品餐厅位于纽约大道旁的戴斯酒店内。

ex.s: My plan was working out just fine.
ex.t: 它们用鼻子来评估环境并留意任何危险的迹象。

ex.s: Studies show teaching children how to cook at an early age helps with reading comprehension and fine motor ability, in addition to learning about nutrition and food safety.
ex.t: 研究表明，在幼年教孩子做饭有助于阅读理解能力和精细动作能力，此外还有助于学习营养和食品安全知识。

ex.s: Nanxiang aside, the best Xiao long bao have a fine skin, allowing them ____41____ (lift) out of the steamer basket without allowing them tearing or spilling any of ____42____ (they) contents.
ex.t: 撇开南翔不谈，最好的小笼包皮薄，能让它们被____41____（lift）从蒸笼里取出而不会破皮，也不会洒出____42____（they）里面的东西。

ex.s: The Palace Museum has the most remarkable collection of fine clocks in the world, mainly _________ from Europe and China.
Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

ex.s: We all want to hope things will turn out fine.
ex.t: 我们都希望事情最终会好转。

ex.s: Whatever it is, the result is a fine and vivid description of the purest of Central Asian traditions.
ex.t: 无论它是什么结果是对最纯粹的中亚传统生动而精彩的描述。

ex.s: There are four fantastic galleries to visit from fine art to interactive fun, so there’s something for everyone!
ex.t: 有四个精彩的展厅可供参观，从美术到互动娱乐，应有尽有！

ex.s: Fire extinguishers are located on each floor and in each apartment． Use a fire extinguisher only if you have been trained to do so． Irresponsible use of a fire extinguisher can create a dangerous situation for other residents and could result in damage to personal property． Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines．
ex.t: •如果烟雾探测器发出警报但没有火灾或烟雾，通知宿舍工作人员。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: "例如，我们大多数人可能预期老年驾驶员总是比别人慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现他们在30英里/小时的区域内很难保持匀速，因此更容易超速并有被罚款的风险。

ex.s: This place is good for a candlelit dinner or a work meeting with colleagues who appreciate fine food.
ex.t: 这个地方适合烛光晚餐，也适合与懂得欣赏美食的同事举行工作聚餐。

ex.s: To me, there's nothing better than a cross-cultural afternoon tea of English biscuits and a cup of Chinese oolong tea in a fine china cup!
ex.t: 对我来说，没有什么比在精致的瓷杯中享受一场跨文化的下午茶——英式饼干配一杯中国乌龙茶——更美好了！

ex.s: If you’ve had a bad day, do you tell your parents about it, or do you hide your tears and lie that your day was “fine”?
ex.t: 如果你今天过得很糟糕，你会告诉父母吗，还是隐藏泪水，撒谎说你的日子"还行"？

ex.s: Beyond that the colours darkened into fine shades of deep blue, and gradually disappeared.
ex.t: 在那之外，颜色变深，变成了深蓝色的精细色调，然后逐渐消失了。

ex.s: We were walking on fine, even sand, not wrinkled, as on a flat shore, which keeps the impression of the waves.
ex.t: 我们走在细密平整的沙上，没有褶皱，像平坦的海岸一样，保留着波浪的印记。

defs.def: used to say you are satisfied with sth （表示满意）很好，不错，满意
pleasing to look at 好看的；漂亮的
attractive and delicate 精巧的；精美的
bright and not raining 晴朗的
very thin or narrow 纤细的；很细的
difficult to see or describe 难以看出的；很难描述的

ex.s: Every autumn, millions of these beautiful insects with fine black and orange wings begin a long and difficult journey.
ex.t: 每年秋天，数以百万计的这种带有精细的黑色和橙色翅膀的美丽昆虫开始一段漫长而艰难的旅程。

defs.def: made of very small grains 小颗粒制成的；颗粒细微的
that you have a lot of respect for 值得尊敬的；杰出的
sounding important and impressive but unlikely to have any effect 漂亮的；虚饰的；辞藻华丽的
containing only a particular metal and no other substances that reduce the quality 纯的；无杂质的
